sources.title: Time Limits in Reinforcement Learning
sources.evidence: Distinguishes task deadlines from externally imposed cutoffs; a remaining-time feature matters when deadline is part of the task. Hopper photo-finish example illustrates short-horizon performance need not persist.
sources.limits: Learning objective/bootstrapping paper, not validation of this paired evaluation or a v22 timeout bug. Does not justify changing frozen observations/policies.

sources.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
sources.evidence: Distinguishes independent training runs from tasks/evaluation episodes and motivates uncertainty-aware few-run interpretation.
sources.limits: No sufficient-three-seed guarantee; repeated windows and history variants are not training replicates.
